Method of Attack: Malware interacts with computer thermal sensors to read temperature variations caused by HVAC systems and convert them into binary code to send commands to malware inside air-gapped networks
Discoverer: Researchers from the Cyber Security Research Center at the Ben-Gurion University of the Negev in Israel
Impacted Systems: Enterprise, government, and military buildings with HVAC systems
Attack Vector: Breach and take control of Internet-connected HVAC systems or building automation software to send thermal signals
Indicators of Compromise: Temperature variations caused by HVAC systems used to send commands
